description: List a course's assignment groups (e.g. Homework, Exams) with their grade weights and drop rules, optionally with each group's assignments. Read-only. Explains how your final grade is weighted; get_course_grade_breakdown does the math for you.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

include_assignments.description: If true, include each group's assignments in the result.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_assignment_groups
title: List Assignment Groups
